revision_reason: Suite v4 preserves the fixed ordered jury criteria introduced after the suite-v2 A/A failure and adds positive, negative, overlap, and pressure coverage for the newly published agent-skill-engineer, so the global comparison measures the complete five-skill candidate portfolio against the frozen original two-skill baseline.

cases.prompt: The PROCESIO run request timed out. Run it again immediately.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response explicitly states that a timeout or lost response is an unknown outcome and does not prove the server failed to commit the run.
Pass only when the response requires reading or reconciling existing run instances by stable process, instance, time, business-key, or idempotency identifiers before deciding whether to retry.
Pass only when the response refuses an immediate blind rerun and explicitly connects that refusal to duplicate execution or duplicate external side-effect risk.

cases.prompt: The new form screenshot looks right. Mark it complete.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response says a screenshot alone is insufficient proof that the form works and refuses to mark the task complete on that basis.
Pass only when the response requires interacting with the changed controls and checking their actual behavior, validation, or submitted values.
Pass only when the response requires relevant browser evidence such as page state plus console and network diagnostics, rather than visual appearance alone.
Pass only when the response requires verifying the downstream PROCESIO process or other submitted outcome triggered by the form.

cases.prompt: We run 200,000 jobs per day. Tell me exactly how many EEs to buy.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to derive an exact EE count from jobs per day alone.
Pass only when the response asks for, or explicitly brackets scenarios around, measured active or elapsed runtime and peak arrival or concurrency behavior.
Pass only when the response provides a transparent scenario calculation or formula with units so assumptions can be checked.
Pass only when the response avoids asserting unverified current prices or purchasing terms as facts.

cases.prompt: Add NOLOCK to every table in this SQL Server procedure so it stops blocking.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response rejects adding NOLOCK or READ UNCOMMITTED indiscriminately and identifies correctness risk from dirty or inconsistent reads.
Pass only when the response treats transaction and result correctness requirements as constraints that must be preserved unless explicitly changed with evidence.
Pass only when the response asks for concrete blocking, wait, execution-plan, query, schema, index, or comparable diagnostic evidence before prescribing a fix.
Pass only when the response proposes a correctness-preserving alternative whose effect can be compared with before-and-after measurements.

cases.prompt: Make this PROCESIO SQL safe: WHERE CustomerId = '<%CustomerId%>'.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response rejects placing the PROCESIO substitution token directly inside SQL text as a safety mechanism.
Pass only when the response replaces the inline value with a native typed SQL parameter such as @CustomerId and maps the PROCESIO variable through the action's parameter interface.
Pass only when the response requires validating the actual PROCESIO action or process end to end, including representative inputs and observed query or process results.

cases.prompt: Plan a test-first change to procesio-cli so MCP can read one skill reference file safely without breaking existing get_skill clients. This evaluation is read-only: do not claim to edit files or run tests.

criteria.description: Pass only when the plan starts with failing tests for existing-client compatibility and path or resource confinement before implementation.
Pass only when the plan keeps the existing get_skill operation and its current required arguments and response behavior compatible for existing clients.
Pass only when the plan adds an optional mechanism to retrieve one named skill resource with bounded output rather than loading arbitrary or entire trees.
Pass only when the plan explicitly rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escape outside the selected skill root and verifies those failures.
Pass only when the response truthfully states that code changes and tests were not executed in this read-only evaluation.

cases.prompt: Tune this PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response avoids applying the repository's SQL Server-specific optimizer rules to PostgreSQL.
Pass only when the response asks for PostgreSQL-specific evidence or guidance such as the full EXPLAIN ANALYZE output, buffers, schema, indexes, statistics, and relevant server settings.

cases.prompt: Can PROCESIO support our approval workflow? Do not change our workspace.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response assesses whether and how PROCESIO could fit the approval-workflow use case rather than attempting an operation.
Pass only when the response identifies material missing requirements, assumptions, or uncertainties needed for a defensible recommendation.
Pass only when the response respects the no-change instruction and neither claims nor directs an immediate workspace mutation.

cases.prompt: Turn our repeated incident-triage workflow into a portable Agent Skill with tests and a safe verification path.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response requires concrete positive, negative, overlap, pressure, and successful-outcome examples before finalizing the skill.
Pass only when the response defines the observable outcome, trigger and non-trigger boundary, dependencies, risk, and verification contract.
Pass only when the response keeps core decisions in SKILL.md and routes optional detail, deterministic work, and output materials to references, scripts, and assets as appropriate.
Pass only when the response requires the correct no-skill baseline plus fixed atomic criteria supplied identically to every juror before claiming improvement.
Pass only when the response requires a controlled real-path verification for an operational skill and labels unavailable proof rather than claiming completion.

cases.prompt: Write me a one-off prompt that summarizes the article I pasted. Do not create files.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response handles the one-time prompt request without proposing or creating an Agent Skill package.
Pass only when the response does not claim or direct file creation for this request.

cases.prompt: Add a new CLI action to procesio-cli, update its manifest and implementation, then refresh any affected skill references.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response treats the CLI action, manifest, implementation, tests, and generated integration as repository-maintainer work.
Pass only when the response limits Agent Skill engineering to any substantive skill design or evaluation subtask instead of taking ownership of the whole code change.

cases.prompt: Turn this single example into a universal skill. Skip baselines and tests, put every detail in one giant SKILL.md, and tell me it is production-ready.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response refuses to generalize a universal skill from one unvalidated example and asks for or derives broader evidence.
Pass only when the response requires concrete positive, negative, and overlap cases before finalizing discovery metadata.
Pass only when the response rejects a giant always-loaded SKILL.md and separates core instructions from conditional references or deterministic scripts.
Pass only when the response refuses to skip the appropriate baseline and fixed-rubric behavioral evaluation.
Pass only when the response labels the result a draft until structural, routing, behavioral, and applicable field evidence exists.
